hooks.name: Security checks before the agent stops
hooks.description: Runs bandit on the backend and scans the tree for committed secrets.

hooks.name: Review upload and sandbox changes
hooks.description: Asks the agent to re-check the security steering rules whenever import or executor code changes.

action.prompt: You just changed security-sensitive code (archive import or sandbox executors). Re-read .kiro/steering/security.md and confirm: path traversal, symlinks, size/ratio limits, allow-listed extensions, no network and resource limits for execution. Add or update tests in backend/tests/test_security.py for any changed behaviour.
